bead.title: Reduce hybrid claim/finalize hot-path latency
bead.description: The hybrid performance evidence bead pqueue-1363098f closed with a release blocker: docs/perf/evidence/performance_object_log_hybrid_smoke.jsonl reports bars_met=false because objectlog/hybrid claim/finalize p95 was 1.610x objectlog/inmemory, above the 1.200x gate. Do not cut a release over this. Diagnose and reduce hybrid claim/finalize hot-path latency while preserving SQLite-first durability, memory hot reads, poison-on-memory-failure, and request-id replay. Likely areas: HybridProjectionStore apply path, forced-seal read-modify-write path, unnecessary SQLite/memory double work, benchmark config artifacts, or missing batching in claim/finalize measurement. Out of scope: weakening the performance gate or removing the SQLite durable apply requirement.
bead.acceptance:
1. PQUEUE_LEDGER_DIR=docs/perf/evidence cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_smoke -- --nocapture passes and writes a row with measurements.bars_met=true.
2. rg -n '"bars_met":true|hybrid_claim_finalize_p95_vs_inmemory_ratio' docs/perf/evidence/performance_object_log_hybrid_smoke.jsonl docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md shows the passing ratio is <=1.20.
3. cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite hybrid_chaos -- --nocapture passes.
4. cargo test --workspace --all-features passes.
5. cargo fmt --check passes.
